role: Runtime raster input for a local hybrid prototype; not a concept-only image
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production grayscale terrain texture atlas for a 1930s grand-strategy political map. Create ONE square 2-by-2 atlas with four equal square panels, precisely aligned at the midpoint, without labels, borders, gutters or text. These pixels will actually become map shading, NOT a concept mood board. Orthographic overhead cartographic miniature relief, crisp moderately bold silhouettes, consistent lighting from upper left. Monochrome grayscale ONLY. Uniform medium-light gray ground (approximately RGB 180) around features; highlights light gray (230), shadows dark gray (60), no black outlines or colored hues. NO global gradients or vignettes.
Top LEFT quadrant: rolling HILLS, smooth rounded low hummocks and short gently connected ridges with broad shaded slopes, varied size and direction, visible quiet valleys, NO sharp mountain peaks, NO contour-line pattern.
Top RIGHT: tropical JUNGLE, dense overlapping rounded broadleaf canopy crowns seen overhead, large clustered irregular masses separated by a few narrow ground clearings, readable lobed tree crowns and dark small gaps; no mountains or rivers.
Bottom LEFT: MARSH, scattered irregular shallow dark-gray pools connected by short winding channels, clumps of clearly recognizable reed stems on their banks, lots of plain ground between wetlands, NO trees.
Bottom RIGHT: URBAN, many small 1930s low-rise building rooftops in irregular groups, rectangles and pitched roofs with directional shadows, open street corridors between blocks, no modern skyscrapers, no city perspective.
In every 512x512 quadrant have about 12-20 medium-sized features, not microscopic noise. Fill the quadrants naturally to their edges without obvious central focal point. The four classes must be distinguishable when each quadrant is reduced to 128x128. Original artwork only. No UI, province borders, compass, labels, watermark or typography.
